project_info.theme: premium Adidas Originals fashion sale advertisement
project_info.color_palette: black, cream, white, warm concrete, and soft architectural shadows

main_subject.description: Two stylish adult models: one confident adult man with a sharp jawline and styled hair, crouching in front; one elegant adult woman with soft features and long hair standing beside him. Both look slightly off-camera with confident expressions.
main_subject.wardrobe: The man wears a black Adidas tracksuit with white three-stripes and white sneakers. The woman wears a beige or cream Adidas cropped sweatshirt with matching joggers and white sneakers. Visible Adidas logos and signature stripes are retained.
main_subject.pose: Male model in a powerful crouched pose; female model standing beside him with relaxed posture and one hand in a pocket.
main_subject.styling: Luxury sportswear editorial styling with polished natural grooming.

composition_elements.framing: Slightly low cinematic angle with balanced square framing and negative space for text.
composition_elements.environment: Modern architectural outdoor setting with warm concrete planes, clean lines, soft natural daylight, and aesthetic shadows.
composition_elements.typography: Top left: 35% OFF in bold clean typography with Adidas logo below. Top right: ADIDAS ORIGINALS COLLECTION. Lower left tagline: MOVE YOUR WORLD. WEAR YOUR CONFIDENCE. Bottom-center CTA button: SHOP NOW. Render all text accurately and legibly.
composition_elements.focus: Sharp adult models, tracksuit fabric, three-stripes, footwear, architectural geometry, and balanced commercial typography.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Soft natural light with gentle architectural shadows, warm highlights, and crisp but flattering detail across the models and clothing.
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Luxury, editorial, confident, modern, and commercially polished.

technical_specs.camera: Full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at f/5.6, 1/250 s, ISO 100, slightly low angle
technical_specs.quality: Ultra-realistic high-detail fashion advertising photography, sharp focus, clean typography, 4K-quality texture and natural skin

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a premium 1:1 Adidas Originals fashion advertisement in a modern architectural outdoor setting with warm concrete planes, clean lines, soft natural light, and aesthetic shadows. Feature two stylish adults: a confident adult man with sharp jawline and styled hair crouching in front, wearing a black Adidas tracksuit with white three-stripes and white sneakers; and an elegant adult woman with soft features and long hair standing beside him, wearing a beige or cream Adidas cropped sweatshirt with matching joggers and white sneakers. Both gaze slightly off-camera. Use a slightly low cinematic angle, balanced framing, and negative space for accurate legible typography: 35% OFF top left with Adidas logo below, ADIDAS ORIGINALS COLLECTION top right, MOVE YOUR WORLD. WEAR YOUR CONFIDENCE. lower left, and a SHOP NOW button bottom center. Preserve visible Adidas logos and signature stripes, with ultra-realistic 4K-quality fashion detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, age ambiguity, unapproved identity, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, explicit body measurements, illegible text, misspelled brand name, distorted logo, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, watermark, cluttered layout, harsh overexposure

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No identity reference is required for these original adult models. Optional wardrobe, architecture, typography, or lighting references may replace only their named element; preserve the Adidas branding, exact offer copy, two-adult composition, and premium sportswear campaign intent.
